mission: Real pretrained pathologic detection across more anatomic regions before multimodel comparison, UI or LLM orchestration

evidenceStates.real_case_measured: genuine isolated inference observed on one public research volume, NOT validated
evidenceStates.real_trial_running: code and independent real-model action started but metric not yet verified
evidenceStates.real_checkpoint_candidate: publisher describes real trained weights, case/rights/protocol still untested
evidenceStates.license_blocked: weights not authorized or legal use limited; do not download
evidenceStates.weights_unverified: no permissible reproducible pretrained pathological model demonstrated

priorityPrinciples: Cover an as-yet unserved pathology/organ/modality before comparing 2 existing detectors
Require actual pretrained checkpoint, source geometry, manual references when available
No real patient clouds; only rights-cleared public deidentified study and numeric nonimage CI artifacts
No model promotion based on one in-training scan or unsupported success tests
Keep research-only, license-blocked and unverified weights outside deployable inference
